questions.prompt: Rewrite our published press release in a public chatbot, signed in with your personal account.
Paste this quarter's results, out next week, into the company AI assistant to draft talking points.
Ask the code assistant to review a pull request with no secrets in it.
Upload a list of 2,000 customer emails to the company AI assistant to plan a campaign.
Support Copilot drafts a reply to a customer complaint. You edit and send it.
A supplier invites NoteHawk to your call. You let it take notes.
Use the company AI assistant to rank 300 job applicants by résumé.
Ask the company AI assistant to summarize an internal process doc.
Paste a config file with an API key into the code assistant to debug it.
The company AI assistant takes notes in your team meeting. You told everyone at the start.
TabGenie AI, a browser extension, summarizes a customer contract for you.
Set up the company AI assistant to send replies to customer emails automatically.

badges.name: Data Guardian
badges.rule: Answer every restricted-data question correctly (Q2, Q4, Q9).

badges.name: Clean Streak
badges.rule: Five correct answers in a row.

badges.name: Speak-up Ally
badges.rule: Finish the three Speak up cards.

badges.name: Certified
badges.rule: 10 of 12 correct. Records your policy attestation.
